Admissions

Begin your journey at Panchgani

A clear five-step enrolment process — and a team to guide you through it.

Enrolment process

Five steps to admission

  1. Parents’ interview
  2. Child’s interview
  3. Written exam
  4. Medical history
  5. Blood investigationStd 8 onwards

Important points

  • Admission is subject to performance in the written exam.
  • Students with an addiction history will not be admitted.
  • An undertaking / indemnity on a ₹500 bond is mandatory.
  • Over-age students will not be enrolled.
  • Strict disciplinary action is taken against those who break the rules.

Fees policy

  • Fees are collected in two terms.
  • The first instalment is paid once admission is confirmed.
  • The second instalment is paid in the second semester, after the Diwali holiday.
  • For the balance, parents submit a post-dated cheque along with a promissory note.
  • Competitive coaching courses attract extra fees.

Fee amounts to be added by the school.

FAQs

Questions parents ask

Which levels does the Panchgani campus offer?
Primary, High School (SSC) and Jr. College (HSC), all English-medium.
Is coaching for NEET, JEE, CET, NATA and CA included?
Coaching is offered on campus. Competitive courses attract extra fees.
What is the admission process?
Parents’ interview, child’s interview, written exam, medical history and — from Std 8 — a blood investigation.
How are fees paid?
In two terms: after admission is confirmed and after the Diwali holiday. A post-dated cheque and promissory note secure the balance.
What medical care is available?
A trained nurse is on campus 24/7, a doctor visits for check-ups and the sick bay can keep patients in-house.
Is prayer compulsory?
The call to prayer is given five times a day and Muslim students are expected to offer salah. Basic Islamic education and Quran recitation are emphasised.
Are there supports for students who struggle?
Yes — peer tutors, resident advisors, academic advisors and extra coaching for vernacular-medium students.
